title: Search Console CLI
summary: Google Search Console from the terminal with no packages to install: submit your sitemap, inspect whether Google has indexed a URL, pull the queries ranking 11-20 (your cheapest SEO wins), and run a weekly report that tells your phone how many pages Google has indexed and what changed. The weekly report can now track more than one website (three settings per extra site). Includes a one-page phone flow to approve the Google sign-in when the Mac is headless.
how_to_use: Set up a Desktop OAuth client once (README), then: gsc.py submit-sitemap, gsc.py inspect /some-page, gsc.py queries --min-pos 11 --max-pos 20. Schedule gsc-weekly.sh for the weekly index report. Ask Claude: 'check what Google has indexed on my site'.
requires: Python 3 (built in on macOS), a Google Cloud OAuth Desktop client with the Search Console API enabled, and a Search Console property you own.
